_readme: A WORKING tenancy map for `reeflex-litellm`. Two departments behind one gateway, which is the whole reason tenancy.py exists. Point REEFLEX_LITELLM_TENANCY_MAP_FILE at a copy of this and run `reeflex-litellm tenancy` to see what it binds; there is no default org, so a key that appears in no `bind` table is refused before core is called. Credentials are BY REFERENCE: every value under `evidence` that ends in `_env` is the NAME of an environment variable, never its value -- a map carrying a token or a signing key is a load error, because this is a file operators copy between hosts and paste into tickets. release.yml's fresh-install smoke invokes `reeflex-litellm tenancy` against THIS file, so a release whose CLI cannot load the example we ship is a red release rather than a customer's first surprise.
